experiments.scope: Structural evidence for the binding seven-entry uniform-reservoir P1 table and the full-scale all-head QREP identity. Trials 0..3 build 2^16 candidates into 2^13 packed 256-bit buckets using the exact capped reservoir build layout, normalize in place to guarded query lanes, and scan 2^12 distinct u words. Because this fixture has 19-bit tags, it computes q and QREP per Wsub through the generic path. Every emitted claw is compared with an independent sorted search, its real E16 and post-filter flags are rebuilt, and step 3b runs on every good pair. Trial 4 checks step 3b on the published P8 pair. Trial 5 exhausts all 127 nonempty handler marker subsets and checks exactly 19 operations per marker. Trial 6 exhausts 35,840 q=507..511 ordinary/adjacent polarity cases. Trial 7 separately exhausts all 512 low-nine-bit P values across all 20 full-scale heads and both offsets, checking the common-q identity and the corrected 579/681, ordinary-12/adjacent-14 inventories. This reduced fixture establishes semantics and the synthetic full-scale identity, not full-scale success rates, H2 or H3.
experiments.hypothesis: Every non-aborted working trial has set_mismatches = 0, claw_e16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws, ordinary_lookup_ops = 12, adjacent_lookup_ops = 14, qrep_hoist_ops = 2 and extract_ops = 19. Trial 5 has handler_mismatches = 0 and the charged count is 19 operations per marker; trial 6 has straddle_polarity_cases = 35,840 and straddle_polarity_mismatches = 0; trial 7 has head_common_q_cases = 20,480, head_common_q_mismatches = 0, common_q_values = 512, full_fixed_ops = 579 and full_straddle_extra_ops = 681. No returned collision is expected at this size; the organizer independently checks any returned pair as a complete sha256-r38-prefix-v1 collision. Trial 4: step3b_P8_pair_ok=1 and step3b_P8_pair_ops=3178.

experiments.scope: Reduced paired structural comparison of the correct online joint law (uniform (a1,a0) in (C1&C2)xR9 conditioned on G) with the historical list law (uniform a1 in C1&C2, then uniform a0 conditional on G). Four common-prefix diagnostic replicates use 64 particles, 96 tails per particle and independently generated exact 256-pair pools. Every reported success is rebuilt as a 38-step semi-free-start collision in the PQE-relaxed event. This bounded organizer run checks sampler and rebuild plumbing only; it is not the registered large-run q3 bound, the frozen 288-replicate study, a confidence bound or a fixed-IV collision run.
experiments.hypothesis: Zero rebuild failures under both laws and finite paired diagnostic observations. Returned CV||M pairs are semi-free-start diagnostics, so zero organizer fixed-IV collisions is expected. The four public-seed replicates are not used to derive q3_P or the 0.20-bit allowance; those remain the separately disclosed frozen-study heuristic. A df=3 Student diagnostic uses coefficient 4.5407, but no confidence statement is inferred from four public-seed replicates.
